newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end near 28 pct on tight supply.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end near 28 pct on tight supply.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates rebounded to opening levels by the end of Thursday's session as the market liquidity remained tight, dealers said.
Overnight rates ended at 28 percent, unchanged from the open, rebounding from the day's lows of 27.625 to 27.75 percent.
On Wednesday, rates ended at 27.50/28 percent.
"The lack of liquidity continued," said Karoly Barath of Postabank. "Banks' increased lending activity may be one reason (behind the slack supply)," he said.
